luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0022.trim_scope: i5 eDrive40 / i5 M60 (530i list does not itemise it)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0022.value: BMW Curved Display: 12.3" Information Display + 14.9" Control Display, BMW Operating System 8.5 with QuickSelect; no passenger display mentioned
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0022.notes: US launch press release (May 2023). Listed in the i5 standard-equipment list; the 530i list does not repeat it but the cabin is shared. bmwblog (Jul 2026) says MY2027 technology and iDrive carry over unchanged.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0024.value: Air conditioning and ventilation controlled via the touch function on the 14.9" control display; physical buttons reduced
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0024.notes: BMW says remaining buttons are kept only where they are ideal for fast operation; the release does not list which climate functions (if any, e.g. defrost) keep a hard key. Same interior in EU and CN.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0026.value: Apple CarPlay / Android Auto compatibility standard; wireless operation not stated in fetched sources
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0026.notes: KBB MY2027 lists 'Smartphone Interface' standard without naming the platform.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0027.value: Not stated in fetched US sources (press release only promises 'faster update cycles' with OS 8.5; OTA delivery of AirConsole games)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0027.notes: DE price list lists Remote Software Upgrade as standard (record E0006); US scope not verified.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0029.value: Highway Assistant: attentive hands-free driving up to 85 mph where conditions and speed limits allow, in the Driving Assistance Professional Package; lane change by eye confirmation
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0029.notes: MY2027: cars.com (https://www.cars.com/research/bmw-i5-2027/specs/) lists Driving Assistance Professional Package at $2,500 on i5 eDrive40 with Highway Assistant marked 'term limited'. bmwblog Jul 2026: on the 530i Driving Assistant Plus ($650) now needs the Premium or Executive Package. Compare DE: hands-off only up to 130 km/h (81 mph) on German Autobahn, EUR 5,350 stack.
